notes.title: Blessings & Curses - Coming to Beta Branch Soon
notes.notes:
[b]New major update, "Blessings & Curses" is currently in closed beta testing. After a round of closed testing the update will be available for public beta testing soon.[/b]

The main goal of this update is to offer more variety and replayability between different runs.

[h3]Major Update Content[/h3]
[*] [b]New Blessings Mechanic[/b]
[*] [b]New Curse upgrades[/b]
[*] [b]Enemy overhaul[/b]
[*] [b]Runes reworked[/b]
[*] [b]Character upgrades reworked[/b]
[*] [b]Overhaul of existing upgrades[/b]
[*] [b]New Characters[/b]

[h2]Blessings[/h2]

At certain early levels, players will be given a choice of 3 blessings to take. Blessings offer powerful and varied effects that range from powerful stat boosts to giving you a unique version of an upgrade. Blessings will give you reasons to adapt and try different builds according to the blessings you are given on each run. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42296647/c6ee229415d9200bd65b9d9f34a4688f02ab55df.png[/img]


[h2]Curses[/h2] 

This is a reworked version of the old "tomes" that dropped from bosses. Now when you pick up chests, you'll be offered curses, that offer power with heavy penalties. There are different rarities of curses, with common curses offering simple stat tradeoffs to rare curses that completely alter how your character plays.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42296647/7f96348f37e1ba76c7ce1dda669afdda6a0a1c80.png[/img]


[h2]Enemy overhaul[/h2]

New enemies are being added to bring more interesting challenges! 

Existing boss fights are also reworked, as well as new bosses are being added. Each boss now has unique minions that spawn alongside them for more interesting fights. Normal enemies will not spawn during boss fights anymore to prevent too much clutter.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42296647/fa6a80715a0b897869a7051037e62a5d3defe0ea.gif[/img]


[h2]Runes reworked[/h2]

One of the issues with the old rune system, is that the build you go for is often somewhat defined by the runes you pick before you start a run. This makes it very hard adapt your build on the fly during a run, which is one of the main goals of the new blessing mechanic. Runes have a reworked to be more generally useful. You will also no longer have to pick and choose as all purchased runes will be active in a run.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42296647/5432d33d15d047e4711ebf98ce9d0e93d57b6fb6.gif[/img]


[h2]Character Specializations[/h2]

The old character specific upgrades have been reworked into character "specializations". Instead of getting character upgrades in random order from chests, you'll now be able to pick 1 of 3 "specializations" unique to each character (similar to the current gun evolution system). The specializations are designed to be more powerful and offer a choice of different ways to build your character. The goal of this is to remove frustrating randomness and offer more flexibility to adapt your build each run.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42296647/1caa2988947b30f260ee28141ae99ed413b554e6.png[/img]


[h2]Upgrade perk overhaul[/h2]

Some of the existing upgrades, don't really contribute to interesting builds (like the magnetism upgrades) or are overpowered in almost every build (like the freeze upgrades). Many of these are either reworked, or replaced by new upgrades. 

[h2]New Characters![/h2]

But if you didn't see it in my last update post, here is a sneak peak of the 2 new characters:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42296647/6bdb59184ef5de7f6484036fa70b1e9400c718a1.png[/img]

[b]More to come![/b]

There are more features and quality of life updates that will be added over the course of the beta. I'm really excited to share this new update with you guys. 

Join the [url=https://discord.gg/DtSPxBXtWJ]Discord[/url] to keep up with all things related to 20 Minutes Till Dawn. Thank you so much for your patience, and continued support. 

Best Wishes,
Flanne

notes.title: More Info About What's Coming in the Next Patch
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

The upcoming patch is very substantial and taking a while to finish so I just wanted to give another quick update on what is to come.

[h2]New Characters[/h2]
Here's a small teaser for some of the upcoming new characters!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42296647/6bdb59184ef5de7f6484036fa70b1e9400c718a1.png[/img]

[h2]New Ways to Power Up Your Runs[/h2]
I'm introducing some new systems that'll add more build variety to the game. A quick sneak peek:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42296647/623ee1484a5b6bd16ab9d664a96334962a40a9dc.png[/img]

[h2]Major Upgrade Perk Overhaul[/h2]
I mentioned this in a previous post, but almost all upgrade trees are getting some perks reworked as well as a ton of new upgrade perks are being added. Here's the revolver with some of the new upgrades in action:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42296647/2816c2b7826c9b191ed81bd2604f142eaf7bbc30.gif[/img]

[h2]Endless Mode Rework[/h2]
Some people were concerned from my last news post, when I announced that endless mode is getting removed. So I wanted to clarify that endless will not be a separate mode anymore, and instead, at the end of each won run, you'll have the option to "loop". Starting a new loop, you keep all of your upgrades, and the pool of available upgrades is replaced with a completely different and new set of special upgrades that can be stacked endlessly.

[h2]Performance Improvements[/h2]
I'm rewriting a significant portion of the game's code-base to utilize Unity's DOTS (Data-Oriented Technology Stack), which will drastically improve the game's performance. It should make the game run smooth and lag-free even on low end PCs or the Steam Deck. This is a substantial time investment, and is a major reason why the new patch is taking a while.

There's currently no ETA on the release date for the next patch. Thanks for waiting patiently, and I hope you all enjoy playing the game in the mean time!

By the way, if you are a fan of action roguelike game, you can follow and wishlist my publisher's upcoming title:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2507980/MetaGhost_The_Breaking_Show/

notes.title: Next Patch Delayed / What I'm Working On
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone! In my a previous announcement, I mentioned that a new patch would be coming late in December. However, the upcoming patch ended being much more substantial than what I had initially planned, so it'll be a delayed. I wanted to share a quick update on what I'm working on.

[h3]New Monsters, and Enemies Rebalancing[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42296647/3f50b4e6177a959d1f3df0392c8ecf9de83daf03.gif[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42296647/e4a081bb8dae0a000804b3d1769d712a153ff393.gif[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42296647/c6c55c280f5dd7ccb98d819adc79c3496029433d.gif[/img]

New enemies are coming! Some existing enemies will be reworked as well.

[h3]New Upgrade Perks and Major Rebalancing[/h3]
Some existing upgrades that don't do enough, like Blazing Speed, are getting reworked or replaced. New upgrades and synergies are getting introduced as well!

[h3]Rerolls and other Quality of Life Improvements[/h3]
Rerolls will be a standard feature now, not just a Shana exclusive thing. Shana is also getting reworked alongside this change. Other QoL improvements coming as well (UI for seeing current stats, compendium of upgrades, etc).

[h3]Endless Mode Rework[/h3]
The current endless mode is neither a balanced nor satisfying experience and will be scraped completely. I'm testing some options to replace it.

[h3]So when is the next patch coming?[/h3]
In addition to the above, there's actually quite a bit more content and new systems I'm working on that I'm not ready to reveal. A lot of it is not set in stone so it's tough for me to give an ETA for now. Thanks for being patient and I'll try to give a news update again when I have more to share!

notes.title: 20 Minutes Till Dawn - 1.0 Released!
notes.notes:
After exactly 1 year in Early Access, "20 Minutes Till Dawn" is finally exiting Early Access. Thank you to everyone for playing my game! Thank you so much!

-Flanne

[h1]New Content[/h1]

[h3]Weapon Evolutions![/h3]

All weapon in the game will have 3 unique variants that players will get to choose from once they reach level 20 in a run!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42296647/969a182c9e01b5a478df342e567cd7e4544ba3bb.gif[/img]

[h3]New Weapons[/h3]

[b]Cyclone Sword[/b]
Perform a spin attack to cut through large swarms of monsters with this sword!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42296647/a7ceb25f91f0937918bf21fea0498c9454d0b7e9.gif[/img]

[b]Salvo Knives[/b]
This knife tracks enemies as you run around. Throw a barrage of knives at every tracked enemies.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42296647/ba243e5837667b246fbbabcf2a9732a2e7e2806e.gif[/img]

[b]Watering Gun[/b]
This gun starts with a Spore Flower summon. Water your Spore Flower and it'll shoot out Spores like an artillery, bombarding monsters with a wave of spores.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42296647/8e72b3e4bbb94663e4276c361e5f7c4215ff6e60.gif[/img]

[h3]New Tomes[/h3]
Added 6 new tomes that drop from bosses to add more variety to your builds!

[h1]Balance Changes[/h1]

Magnetism Tree:
Magnetism: Pickup Range increased from 30% to 50%
Excitement: Pickup Range increased from 20% to 30%. Fire rate buff increased from 30% to 50%
Watch and Learn: Pickup Range increased from 15% to 30%.

Vision Tree:
Glare: Base tick rate increased 0.5 tick per second to 1 tick per second. Base damage decreased from 25 to 15.
Saccade: Vision Range increased 10% to 25%

Bullet Damage Tree:
Power Shot: Bullet Damage bonus increased from +35% to +40%
Big Shot: Removed Fire Rate decrease
Repear Round: Bullet Damage bonus increased from +15% to +20%
Splinter: Projectiles spawned have much lower range now.

Dragon Tree:
Aged Dragon: Damage gain increased from 8 to 15

Fire Rate Tree:
Rubber Bullets: Bullet Damage decrease removed
Siege: Ammo refund chance increased from 33% to 40%

Ghost Friend Tree:
Ghost base attack speed decreased from 2 attacks per second to 1.25 attacks per second

Magic Spear Tree:
Magic Spears base attack speed decreased from 1 attack per second to 0.77 attacks per second
Soul Drain: Kills to trigger changed from 400 to 500

Dark Arts Tree:
Curse time to activate decreased from 1 second to 0.75 seconds
Dark Arts: Change to inflict Curse increased from 25% to 35%
Doom: No longer increases Curse time to activate.

Ice Tree:
Freeze Duration decreased from 3 seconds to 1.5 seconds
Shatter: Damage decreased from 10% to 7%

Aero Tree:
Aero Magic: Base damage increased from 10 to 20. Activates every 2 seconds instead of on reload.

Health Tree:
Anger Point: Fire Rate and Reload Rate increased from +50% to +70%. Duration increased from 15 to 30.
Giant: Removed Move Speed decrease.

Soul Heart Tree:
You can have a maximum of 3 Soul Hearts now.
Soul Conversion replaced with Soul Expand: Gain a Soul Heart. Increase max limit of Soul Hearts by +2.
Soul Powered's old effect removed and replaced with: Your bullets deal +10% damage for each Soul Heart you currently have.

Synergies:
Death Rounds: Removed Max HP decrease.
Gun Mastery: Bullet Damage increased from +15% to +30%
Mini Clip: Max Ammo decreased changed from -666 to -4. Reload Rate bonus decreased from +100% to +75%

Characters:
Dasher: Transforms every 10 seconds instead of every 25 kills.
Hastur: Tentacle spawn cooldown decreased from 4 seconds to 3 seconds.
Hina: She is now invulnerable during her dash. Her Shadow Clone's and Hidden Blade's attack range increased.

Weapons:
Dual SMGs base damage increased from 4 to 8. Range reduced.
Batgun damage increased from 8 to 18 but projectiles reduced from 2 to 1.

Runes:
Elemental Shield replaced with Agility: +2% dodge per rank
Last Stand replaced with Premonition: +3% dodge chance cap per rank
Second Wind replaced with Wind Shield: Gain a Wind Shield that blocks an enemy projectile. Wind Shield recharges after 10 seconds. Recharge time reduced by 1 second per rank. 
Guardian replaced with Body and Soul: Every 300 seconds, gain a Soul Heart. Max 3. Increase max limit of Soul Hearts by +1 per rank.

[h1]Other Changes[/h1]
Key rebinding added to options menu.
Added a description of the Dodge Chance cap, on dodge related upgrade perks.
Controller controls scheme slightly changed to hopefully be more comfortable.
Tree Monster: HP decreased from 90,000 to 45,000. Can now be damaged by Frostbite.
[strike]SECRET BOSS[/strike]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
Fixed Grenade Launcher projectiles exploding on Magic Lens
Fixed some of the menu navigation issues with controller.
Fixed Holy Shield giving infinite invlunerability in some situations.
Fixed auto-aim not targeting bosses.
Fixed having too many upgrades would cause the upgrade display UI at the pause menu to overflow onto the rest of the UI.

Thanks again！

notes.title: V0.6.3 - Crossbow and Fire Cannon Rework and Other Balance Changes!
notes.notes:
[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]

Currently on-hit elemental builds are the easiest to clear the game with, while pure gun builds aren't doing so well. I've made some balance adjustments to hopefully make more build viable at clearing the game. I've also reworked the crossbow and fire cannon to hopefully make them more unique. There will be more balance changes to come in the future, as well as new upgrade perks, characters, and weapons, so stay tuned for that. 

[h3]Weapons[/h3]
[list]
[*] Crossbow: Changed passive to - Hold the shoot button to charge. Charging gives more damage and piercing to your bullets.
[*] Fire Cannon: Reworked to behave like a continuously firing, short range flamethrower.
[*] Batgun: Damage increased from 6 to 8. Bounce +1
[*] Dual SMGs: Time to reload changed from 2.5 seconds to 2 seconds. Max ammo reduced from 32 to 24.
[*] Grenade Launcher: Damage increase from 45 to 60. Time for grenades to explode shortened.
[/list]

[h3]Characters[/h3]
[list]
[*] Hina dash damage increased to 3x bullet damage.
[/list]

[h3]Upgrade Perks[/h3]
[list]
[*] Electro Mage: Lightning now strikes enemy closest to your cursor.
[*] Glare: Damage increased from 5 to 25
[*] Dragon: Pierce +1
[*] Powershot: Damage increased to from 25% to 35%
[*] Bigshot: Damage increased from 35% to 45%
[*] Fresh Clip: Damage after reloading increased from 30% to 50%
[*] Firestarter: Launches a fireball every 5th attack instead of every 4th
[*] Frostbite: Damage reduced from 35% to 15% of enemy max HP
[*] Shatter: Damage reduced from 25% to 10% of enemy max HP
[/list]

[h3]Enemies[/h3]
[list]
[*] HP of enemies from 10 minutes to 18 minutes reduced for a smoother difficulty ramp.
[*] Increased how often Shoggoth (laser eye boss) attacks.
[/list]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug with Sight Magic not applying all on-hit effects

notes.title: Killing the framerate is 20 Minutes Till Dawn's secret real win condition
notes.notes:
While the official way to win 20 Minutes Till Dawn is to survive 20 minutes of monster attacks, I disagree. Like in Vampire Survivors, I think the roguelikelike arcade shooter's real victory condition is spewing so many bullets and explosions and fireballs and lightning strikes and ice shards that the framerate starts chugging. As far as I'm concerned, when the game can no longer process just how ridiculous my run is, I've beaten it and I win. Reader dear, I'm delighted to say I finally managed that in 20 Minutes Till Dawn. I finally won.

notes.title: 20 Minutes Till Dawn - Early Access Released!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

[b]20 MINUTES TILL DAWN IS FINALLY OUT IN EARLY ACCESS![/b]

It's been a exciting last few weeks developing 20 Minutes, I can't express enough how thrilled I am to be able to finally share the game with everyone!

In this post, I want detail the current state of Early Access, and what my plans are for development going forward.

The current game is no-doubt still a bit rough around the edges, but I'm very happy overall with the game. With all the new upgrades, runes, and enemies, there will be no doubt, some imbalances in the game. So going forward, I hope that the players can help me balance the game so that all variety of playstyles and builds can be viable and fun to play. Please feel free to give me your feedback in the [url=https://discord.gg/DtSPxBXtWJ]20MTD discord.
[/url]

My next goal is to add a lot more enemy variety as well as bosses. Currently the same bosses appear every run, but I want to add enough bosses so that different random bosses can appear every run, adding more flavor to the challenge. 

Some new maps will also be in the works, to hopefully add more interesting environments to experience.

And lastly, I want to add more upgrades to the game for even more possible builds and playstyles!

Developing 20 Minutes Till Dawn has been an absolute blast. And I'm so appreciative of everyone who's tried the free version 10 Minutes Till Dawn. The amount of feedback I've gotten from it has been incredible. Thank you so much, and I hope you all can continue to give me your feedback to help shape 20 Minutes Till Dawn through its EA journey.

Please enjoy the game. I can't wait to tackle the next stage of development with you all!

Sincerely,
Flanne

notes.title: 10 Minutes Till Dawn Released! (And future plans for 20 Minutes Till Dawn)
notes.notes:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1888430/10_Minutes_Till_Dawn/

[b]10 Minutes Till Dawn[/b] is out now! This is a [b]free, content-limited[/b] version of [b]20 Minutes Till Dawn[/b]. 

For those of you who have already had a chance to check out 10 Minutes Till Dawn through either itch.io or the demo that was up for the "Going Rogue" Festival, there is an extensive list of changes in this official release.

Also, at the bottom of this post, I'll detail what's to come for the full version, [b]20 Minutes Till Dawn[/b]. 

[h2]Changes from the Demo[/h2]

[h3]New Frost Magic Upgrades![/h3]
Turn eldritch monster into ice cubes!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42296649/27945d9b1c34bf3f8fc0991fa6f9b8ade5f43a9b.gif[/img]

[h3]Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added some trees, to spice up the plain environment.
[*] UI now show unlock paths for upgrades
[*] Toned down the level-up strobing light animation.
[*] Added an options menu.
[*] Added a pause feature.
[*] Visually increased the size of the eye monster's projectile for better visibility. The actual hitbox is unchanged.
[*] Enemy death effect color changed to be less noisy.
[*] Added an ammo counter next to your cursor.
[/list]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug that caused Fire Starter to not work.
[*] Fixed bug that caused Boomer enemy's explosion to deal 2 damage to the player instead of 1.
[*] Fixed bug that caused Fusillade to give more projectiles than it was suppose to.
[/list]

[h3]Balance[/h3]
[list]
[*] [Buff] Revolver: Base Fire Rate increased from 3.3 shots per second to 4 shots per second. Reload time changed from 1 second to 0.8 second.
[*] [Buff] Shotgun: Damage increased from 8 to 12. Projectiles lowered from 5 to 4. Reload time changed from 1.2 seconds to 1 second (overall dps buff)
[*] [Buff] Flame Cannon: Fire Rate increased from 2 shots per second to 2.5 shots per second.
[*] [Nerf] Crossbow: Base Damage lowered from 21 to 20. Base Fire Rate lowered from 6.6 shots per second to 4 shots per second (this only matters if you increase ammo above 1).
[*] [Buff] Tome of Summoning: Reload Rate changed from -95% ot -50%.
[*] [Buff] Quick Hands: Reload Rate increased from 15% to 20%.
[*] [Buff] Power Shot: Bullet Damage increased from 20% to 25%.
[*] [Buff] Electro Mastery: Added new effect - increase the area of effect of Lightning Strikes by 75%
[*] [Change] Energetic Friends: Changed from Summon Damage +50% to Summon Attack Speed +50%.
[*] [Change] Swapped the effects and icons of Pyro Mage and Fire Starter (Pyro Mage appears earlier in the upgrade pool).
[*] [Nerf] Splinter: Lowered projectiles shot on enemy kill from 5 bullets to 3 bullets. Splinter damage increased from 10% to 15%.
[/list]

[h3]Localization[/h3]
[list]
[*] Chinese(Simplified) added
[/list]

[h2]Plans for 20 Minutes Till Dawn[/h2]

[h2]More Upgrades![/h2]
More unique upgrades are in the works! In addition to new normal upgrades, there will also be [b]Synergy Upgrades[/b] which will require you to have a specific combination of upgrades to unlock. For example: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42296649/ca1e1011a154ee38581da93df173348a37d25cff.png[/img] [b]Frostfire[/b]
Requires "Intense Burn" and  "Frostbite"
When you inflict Freeze, also inflict Burn for 6 damage per second.

[h2]More Characters And Weapons![/h2]
3 more characters and 3 more weapons are planned for the full version! All with unique playstyles and build possibilities!

[h2]More Game Modes![/h2]
I've heard from players how much they love the short 10 minute format, so I'm planning it as a game mode in the full release. 

Of course there will be the standard 20 minute format as well. This will feature multiple levels of difficulty for players to test their skills.
